prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1256; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid edge is bent, with the taillight assembly broken on the driver side. These marks line up well with the rear-end impact described. The bills show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, straighten the lid, and fit a new taillight assembly. The labor hours look a little high for this scope, so I have asked the shop to review the time allowed for the panel work before final approval.
